_comment: Factory metrics rendered on the site. Owned by scripts/update-metrics.mjs — edit through that, not by hand. `rendered` is the literal text currently present in the HTML; the updater uses it to find and replace, then rewrites it. If you hand-edit a number in a page, update `rendered` in the same commit or the next run will not find it.
method: GitHub search API, org:Bygmedai, default branches only, private repositories included. Commits and pull requests counted from 2026-02-01; a search for commits before that date returns zero, which is what fixes February as the factory's start.

notes.copyrightYear: Appears in the footer of 49 pages. Not a metric, but the same problem: a value quoted everywhere that becomes wrong on a fixed date. The rendered string deliberately includes the name — the bare year appears 278 times across the site in article dates, JSON-LD and body copy, and replacing that would rewrite history rather than a footer.
notes.repositories: 48 is the exact count of repositories in the organisation. The site previously said 30+ as a deliberate lower bound.
notes.solutions: Not derivable from the API — it is a judgement about what counts as a client-facing delivery. Steven has said a 15th exists; it stays at 14 until someone enumerates them. Never auto-updated.
